# Chhaon Stays & Cafe

> A shade & shelter for travellers to recharge and refresh. Mountain hostel and cafe in Shoja, Tirthan Valley, Himachal Pradesh — 3 km from Jibhi.

## About

- **Name:** Chhaon Stays & Cafe (छाँव)
- **Type:** Hostel, homestay, and mountain cafe
- **Location:** NH-305, near Achru, Mahadev Devtasthaan, Shoja, Banjar Tehsil, Himachal Pradesh 175123, India
- **Region:** Tirthan Valley, 3 km from Jibhi
- **Accommodation:** 3 private rooms, 2 dorm rooms, attic space
- **Host:** Amrit (@pahaad_premi on Instagram)
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/chhaonstays

## Contact & Booking

- **WhatsApp / Phone:** +91 96250 05516
- **Alternate phone (travel help):** +91 99530 64180
- **Website:** https://chhaonstays.com/
- **Booking.com:** https://www.booking.com/hotel/in/chhaon-stays-shoja1.html
- **MakeMyTrip:** https://www.makemytrip.com/hotels/chhaon_stays_shoja-details-jibhi.html
- **Hostelworld:** https://www.hostelworld.com/hostels/p/332673/chhaon-stays/

## Highlights

- Rated 5.0 on Google Maps (117 reviews)
- Rated 9.3 on Booking.com (31 reviews)
- Best food in Shoja — famous for spring rolls, egg paratha, caramelised onion egg sandwich, hot chocolate
- Amenities: Free Wi-Fi, hot showers, heating, free parking, pet friendly, coworking space, laundry, garden
- Nearby: Jalori Pass, Raghupur Fort, Serolsar Lake, Jibhi waterfalls

## How to Reach

- **By road from Delhi:** ~500 km, 12–14 hours via Aut – Banjar – Jibhi – Shoja
- **By road from Chandigarh:** ~320 km, 8–10 hours
- **Nearest airport:** Bhuntar (Kullu-Manali), ~57 km, ~1 hour by taxi
- **Nearest bus stop:** Aut on NH-21, ~45 km, ~1.5 hours

Daily 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM. Open to non-guests.
